Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: National Electoral Commission unveiled digital voter registration equipment March 2025 for upcoming local elections.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Upgraded. The originally cited source (March 2025) only described unveiled equipment ahead of registration. Fresher evidence shows the digital biometric voter register has since gone operational and been used in real elections: NIEBC ran biometric registration in Mogadishu (April–Sept 2025, ~923,220-1m registered) with council elections held Nov 2025, followed by South West state, and Galmudug (215,860 registered, election set for 20 July 2026), with registration also expanding to further districts (e.g. Hobyo, April 2026). Coverage remains partial — Puntland and Jubaland are outside the process — so this is 'Partially deployed' (4) rather than 'Fully deployed', but well beyond 'Under development' (3). Score changed 3 → 4.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Unified Social Registry (USR) database/MIS established for poor/vulnerable households, beneficiary selection.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed with fresher evidence. A World Bank project paper (September 2025) for the Shock Responsive Safety Net for Human Capital Project confirms the Unified Social Registry (USR) is operational and actively used for beneficiary targeting (Proxy Means Testing plus District Distress Index geographic targeting) under the Baxnaano cash transfer programme, including co-responsibility cash transfers linked to health and education. This is more current than the 2021 MoLSA ToR originally cited but supports the same 'Partially deployed' rating (4), since the USR is not yet a fully unified, universal register. No change to the code.

Comments: Somalia Revenue Directorate offers digital tax registration, TIN issuance, online filing/payments.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The original URL (revenuedirectorate.gov.so/about) returned corrupted/unreadable binary content on fetch and could not be directly verified. However other live Somalia Revenue Directorate pages confirm a functioning digital tax administration (TIN-linked income/corporate tax forms, a Somali Customs Automated System). A Ministry of Finance publication confirms the underlying Financial Management Information System 'provides basic revenue receipting and Tax Identification Number (TIN) generation functionalities' and that a fuller Integrated Tax Administration System is still being developed/procured. This corroborates 'Partially deployed' (4) rather than fully deployed; no change to the code, but the source has been refreshed.
